title: Fault Extension for Certificates on Tailwise-Fault Returns — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** When a certificate used on an order is reissued after the order is refunded on return, a fault extension is added to the reissue validity according to the return reason and the refund date recorded on the Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders return refund.

**Fault reasons:** damaged, defective, wrong item, not as described.

| Return reason | Refund dated, counted back from the reissue date | Fault extension |
|---|---|---|
| a fault reason | more than 7 calendar days before | 10 days |
| a fault reason | 7 calendar days or fewer before | 5 days |
| any other reason | any | none |

**Both sides (hypothetical, refund on 1 June, reason damaged).** Reissue on 8 June (7 days after the refund): 5 days. Reissue on 9 June (8 days): 10 days.

**Other reasons (hypothetical).** A return refunded for a reason outside the four fault reasons adds no fault extension, however long ago the refund was made.
